actions.label: Manage crop residue without burning
actions.photo: Happy Seeder, baler or decomposer at work, or residue mulched into an unburnt field
actions.why: Stubble smoke is the biggest single source in Punjab-Haryana-Delhi in Oct-Nov.

actions.label: Switch a home to LPG or electric cooking
actions.photo: The new LPG or induction stove in use in a home kitchen
actions.why: Wood and dung stoves fill homes and villages with PM2.5.

actions.label: Plant a native tree or sapling
actions.photo: The sapling freshly planted in the ground, with soil, hands or a tool in frame
actions.why: Trees catch dust and cool streets for decades, if they survive.

actions.label: Join a clean-up drive
actions.photo: People collecting litter, or filled garbage bags at the site
actions.why: Litter that is cleared is litter that never gets burned.

actions.label: Get a vehicle emission (PUC) check
actions.photo: The PUC certificate or the vehicle at the testing centre
actions.why: A tuned engine emits far less soot and NOx.

actions.label: Report open waste burning
actions.photo: The burning waste pile or its smoke, photographed at the site
actions.why: Open waste fires are a large, fixable winter source.

actions.label: Cycle or walk instead of driving
actions.photo: Your bicycle on the road or path, or your walking route
actions.why: Every trip off the road is exhaust that never happens.

actions.label: Water or protect a tree you planted
actions.photo: A young tree being watered, or with a tree guard
actions.why: Most planted saplings die in the first year without care.

actions.label: Take the metro or bus instead of driving
actions.photo: Inside the metro or bus, or the station platform
actions.why: One bus replaces dozens of cars on the road.

actions.label: Segregate or compost household waste
actions.photo: Separate wet and dry bins, or your compost pit or bin
actions.why: Segregated waste gets recycled instead of burned at the dump.

actions.label: Share a ride
actions.photo: Several people sharing one car, cab or auto
actions.why: Fewer cars, less exhaust and less road dust.
